title: Shedding light on overpotentials and underpotentials in (photo)electrochemical reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,3737-3765
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00695J, Tutorial Review
Daiki Nishiori, Edgar A. Reyes Cruz, Lillian K. Hensleigh, Nghi P. Nguyen, Gary F. Moore
Overpotential requirements are central to catalytic performance. This article provides an overview of overpotentials in electrochemical versus photoelectrochemical reactions and considers their enthalpic versus entropic contributions.
